description.value: Mayne Island Trading Post is a convenience store located in Miners Bay on Mayne Island, one of BC's southern Gulf Islands accessible only by BC Ferries. As the island has very limited services, this store is a critical supply stop for touring cyclists riding the Gulf Islands circuit. Cyclists arriving from the ferry terminal will find it centrally positioned in the small village core.

address.value: 413 Fernhill Rd, Mayne Island, BC V0N 2J0, Canada
